name: Workflow
description: Review a dependency graph of steps before running each in a native task conversation.
author: Modera
agentGuidance: When the user asks to create a workflow, call workflow_draft with 2–8 concrete steps. For parallel branches or joins, set each step's optional after field to the 1-based numbers of its direct prerequisites; omitted after means the preceding step. Keep the graph acyclic. This only saves a draft. The user reviews and starts it in the workflow card or project workbench; do not execute it yourself.

tools.title: Draft a workflow
tools.description: Save a reviewable 2–8 step workflow draft with optional step dependencies for the current project. No step runs until the user presses Start.

zh-CN.name: 工作流
zh-CN.description: 先审阅步骤，再逐步执行复杂任务。
